obligations.expected_behavior: Detached positive Probes execute as real independent processes and receive bound inputs while producing bound outputs.
forbidden_result: Positive Probes execute in-process or without bound inputs or outputs.
obligations.observable_result: A positive Probe process runs independently and its bound input and output are observable.

obligations.state_before: Detached positive Probe execution is not yet established as an independent process with bound inputs and outputs.
obligations.subject: Detached positive Probe execution
obligations.trigger: When a detached positive Probe is executed.

obligations.expected_behavior: A false negative caused by an always-success result fails the requirement.

obligations.state_before: An always-success false negative may not yet be rejected.
obligations.subject: Always-success false-negative handling
obligations.trigger: When a Probe produces an always-success result where a negative outcome is required.

obligations.expected_behavior: A false negative caused by an infrastructure failure fails the requirement.
